```{=html}
<style>
	/* Responsive emulator container */
	.chip8-wrap{ display:flex; justify-content:center; }
	#chip8-app{ width:100%; max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 12px; }
	#canvas{ width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio: 900 / 700; background:#000; border-radius:0px; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.15); }
</style>
<div class="chip8-wrap">
	<div id="chip8-app">
		<canvas class="emscripten" id="canvas" oncontextmenu="event.preventDefault()" tabindex="0" width="900" height="700" style="touch-action:none; outline:none;"></canvas>

	</div>
</div>

<script>
// Mirror the Module expected by raylib/Emscripten from main.html
var Module = {
	// Print only to console; do not spam the page
	print: function(text){ if (arguments.length > 1) text = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments).join(' '); console.log(text); },
	canvas: document.getElementById('canvas'),
	// Ensure wasm/data are located next to main.js
	locateFile: function(path) { return './' + path; }
};
	// Basic status reporting
	Module.setStatus = function (text) {
		var el = document.getElementById('output');
	if (el) el.textContent = (text || '').toString();
	};
	Module.printErr = function (text) {
		console.error(text);
		var el = document.getElementById('output');
	// Keep errors minimal on page
	if (el) el.textContent = (el.textContent || '') + '\n' + text;
	};
	// Ensure canvas receives focus for keyboard input
	(function(){
		var canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
		if (!canvas) return;
		// Focus after load
		window.addEventListener('load', function(){ try { canvas.focus(); } catch(e){} });
		// Focus on click/touch
		['click','pointerdown','touchstart'].forEach(function(ev){
			canvas.addEventListener(ev, function(){ try { canvas.focus(); } catch(e){} }, { passive: true });
		});
		// Prevent the page from hijacking arrow keys (optional)
		canvas.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
			// Common keys used by emulators; allow Module to handle them
			var prevent = ['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight',' '].includes(e.key);
			if (prevent) e.preventDefault();
		});
	})();
</script>
<script src="./main.js"></script>
```

This browser-playable CHIP-8 emulator is written in C with Raylib and compiled to WebAssembly with Emscripten. Click or tap the canvas to focus it before using the keyboard.

## Controls

- **Spacebar:** Pause or resume emulation

The emulator uses the standard CHIP-8 hexadecimal keypad layout:

<div style="max-width: fit-content; margin: auto;">

|   |   |   |   |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2 | 3 | C |
| 4 | 5 | 6 | D |
| 7 | 8 | 9 | E |
| A | 0 | B | F |

</div>

## Build for the Web

Compile the project with the Emscripten SDK and link it against Raylib's web library:

```bash
emcc -o main.html src/main.c -Os -Wall C:/raylib/raylib/src/libraylib.web.a -I. \\
-Iinclude -IC:/raylib/raylib/src -L. -LC:/raylib/raylib/src/libraylib.web.a -s \\
USE_GLFW=3 -s ASYNCIFY -s WASM=1 --preload-file resources@/resources --shell-file minshell.html -DPLATFORM_WEB
```

Source code: [chip8-raylib](https://github.com/Ajeets6/chip8-raylib)
